title: GitHub Search Tool Integration
summary: This module provides a tool for performing semantic searches within GitHub repository content, leveraging RAG capabilities to retrieve relevant information. It allows specifying repositories and content types for targeted searches.

nodes.label: GithubSearchTool
nodes.title: GitHub Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within specified GitHub repositories, using a GitHub token for access and filtering by content types like code, issues, or pull requests. It leverages RAG for intelligent retrieval.

nodes.label: Base RAG Tool
nodes.title: Base RAG Tool
nodes.description: Provides the foundational Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities, handling data ingestion, indexing, and semantic similarity searches for various data sources.

nodes.label: GitHub Repository
nodes.title: GitHub API/Repository
nodes.description: Represents the external GitHub platform, providing access to repository content, code, issues, and pull requests, which are then ingested for semantic search.

nodes.label: RAG Data Processing
nodes.title: RAG Data Processing
nodes.description: Manages the indexing, vectorization, and retrieval logic for the RAG system. It processes ingested data to enable efficient semantic search queries.

nodes.label: User Search Query
nodes.title: User Search Query
nodes.description: The natural language query provided by a user or agent to search for information within the configured GitHub repositories.

nodes.label: Semantic Search Results
nodes.title: Semantic Search Results
nodes.description: The relevant information retrieved from the GitHub repository content based on the semantic search query, presented as structured or summarized text.

groups.label: Tool Interface
groups.title: GitHub Search Tool Interface
groups.description: Encapsulates the primary tool for interacting with GitHub content search.

groups.label: RAG Core
groups.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Core
groups.description: Handles the underlying RAG mechanisms for data management and semantic retrieval.

groups.label: External Data Source
groups.title: GitHub Repository Data
groups.description: Represents the external source of data (GitHub) that is queried and processed.

groups.label: User Interaction
groups.title: User Input and Output
groups.description: Defines the entry point for user queries and the format of the returned search results.
